heading: Settings

languages.heading: Language packs
languages.description: Each pack downloads or installs a language server (LSP) so semantic tools — find references, hover, diagnostics — work for that language.
languages.uninstall_confirm: Uninstall {{name}}? This removes the managed binary; PATH installs are not touched.
languages.install_managed: Install Oxyris-managed copy alongside the PATH version

claude_language_desc: Language Claude answers in. "Auto" mirrors the language you write in instead of drifting toward the (mostly English) code and context. Applies to new sessions.
update_disabled: Updater not configured yet — run `bun tauri signer generate` and publish the first signed release.
notifications_sound_desc: Sounds play only when the window is not focused. Pick a different sound per channel, or set either to off.
notifications_channel_completion_desc: Played when Claude finishes a turn on its own (orange attention bull).
notifications_channel_input_desc: Played when Claude is paused waiting on you (red bull / approval prompt).
notifications_channel_escalation_desc: Played when the auto-pilot gets stuck on a human-only step (create an account, log in, payment…) and hands control back.
notifications_channel_mission_desc: Played when the auto-pilot finishes its mission and shuts itself off on that thread.
pure_mode_desc: Replaces the structured chat with the real interactive Claude Code running in a terminal. Index, LSP and workspace stay wired in. Applies to all projects.
default_runtime_desc: Mode used when you start a thread from the one-click "New thread" button or a Multi View tile (no picker there). In-thread pickers still override per session.
default_runtime_danger_warning: Danger: new threads run with all permission checks skipped (--dangerously-skip-permissions). Claude can edit files and run commands without asking.
autopilot_desc: Default supervisor used to drive sessions toward a mission. Used when you engage the auto-pilot from a thread, and when Claude Code hands a session off to it. Each thread can still override the backend per run.
open_external_desc: When you Ctrl/Cmd+click a file path in a terminal, open it in your external editor instead of the in-app modal editor.
section_keybindings_desc: Edit your shortcuts as JSON. Saved to disk; reloaded on restart.
section_devtools_desc: Open the Tauri WebView devtools with F12 (or right-click → Inspect).
interop_hint: This claude binary is the Windows install seen from inside WSL. Install claude natively in the distro for correct routing.
